title: 第7章 剑柄

content_zh:
姜韵说着，眼中也不由显出了憧憬之色。
似乎，天元这个境界，是她一辈子的梦想一样。
姜辰将这一幕默默的看在眼中。
此时的姜韵，美丽的眸子里蕴含着向往、憧憬之色，她一身淡紫色的纱裙下，拥有完美的身材。
窈窕的身影和那种出尘的气质，以及那一份淡淡的宁秀气质，让这一幕，显得格外的美丽。
这一幕，也如定格一样，被姜辰牢牢的记在了心中。
姜辰没有打破这份美好的画面，但姜韵很快便回过神来，目光再次的落在姜辰的身上。
“好吧，那以后，我给你数不清的真元丹，让你吃到吐。”
姜辰说道。
“粗俗！”
“嘿黑。”
“姜辰，你不想去天剑宗，那你以后，打算怎么办？没有宗门的资源和竞争，我们修士，很难有大的发展。”
“师姐，我记得，你姑姑，是在万剑宗对吗？”
“是，只是……万剑宗与万雪宫比邻，你这是……要随时可以与万雪宫比斗吗？”
“是啊师姐，万剑宗比天剑宗更大一些，也更适合成长。而万剑宗的弟子每年都会与万雪宫大比，我想去万剑宗，想在大比上，狠狠的踩死古昊啊！”
姜辰沉思片刻后，说出了自己的心声。
“你——古昊，如今已经是天元境五重，你……你拿什么去比呢？而且，万剑宗，哪怕是我姑姑的能力，也不见得能让你进去，你的情况……”
“师姐，我只要一个考核的机会。成不成，只要自己尽力了就好。”
“万剑宗，最低进入门槛，是真元境。”
“我已经有紫气境九重的实力了。”

“什么，你你你竟然紫气境九九九九重了！”
听到姜辰的话，姜韵一震，瞪大了美丽的双眼，死死的盯着姜辰，眼中满是不可思议之色！
“嗯，是的。”
姜辰说着，紫气境九重的实力直接展现了出来。
果然，一股浩荡的紫气溢出，姜韵的脸上，显出了极为震惊之色。
随即，她一下冲到了姜辰面前，然后伸手就揪住姜辰的耳朵，狠狠的拧着。
“你这个没良心的！姐姐我为了你担心了三年，你却装着颓废，反而暗中苦修恢复了实力！你真是没良心，没良心！”
姜韵非常的激动，拧着姜辰的耳朵的时候，却又根本舍不得用力，反而拧着拧着，便泪如雨下。
姜辰听到这句话，顿时心灵一震，一种莫名的复杂感情震着他的身心。
他无法自控，下意识的狠狠的抱住了姜韵。
一下抱住，姜辰立刻感觉到姜韵都在颤着。
姜辰知道，这是姜韵高兴和激动的。
不过，感动之后，姜辰抱着这大美人，竟是心中立刻热了起来。
他本就来自于现代社会，思想也不是什么正人君子。
因而，姜辰心中火，立刻顺势搂抱得更紧。
同时，姜辰的手，也丝毫不老实。
开始的时候，姜韵还没感觉，只觉得三年的牵挂和担心，终于有了圆满的答案，心中悲喜加交，也就没有反对姜辰的拥抱。
但随即，她却感受到了。
“你的剑柄，刺到我的腿了。”
姜韵挣开姜辰的怀抱，下意识的说道。

不过刚说完，她立刻会意到了什么，俏脸顿时绯红一片。
“你，你这个登徒子！”
姜韵俏脸更是红晕，顿时轻啐了一口，嗔怒的道。
“这个，这个不是故意的。毕竟师姐你那么动人……”
姜辰讪讪的笑了笑。
本来之前对方还没发现的，不过这情况出现，对方便可以知晓之前自己的举动绝对是趁机占便宜了。
姜韵狠狠的瞪了姜辰一眼，却是明显很是防备的和姜辰拉开了距离。
想到自己之前还拉着他的手各种关心，之后他却反而抚自己的手，姜韵也一阵脸红——只怕是那时候，这登徒子就想着占自己的便宜了！
姜韵俏脸红了，这才将那个纯情的少年，和一个邪恶的青年划上了等号。
“师姐，这个，你之前不是一直喜欢《天河剑诀》吗，我传你《天河剑诀》吧！”
姜辰说着，又看了一眼自己父亲姜苍云的墓碑，原本还不错的心情顿时也立刻黯然了许多。
他走到墓碑侧面，拿出剑，施展出天河剑道，挖出一米见方的坑。
在其中，姜辰取出了一个铁盒。

content_en:
Jiang Yun said, with a look of longing in her eyes.
It seemed that the realm of Tianyuan was her lifelong dream.
Jiang Chen watched this scene silently.
At this time, Jiang Yun's beautiful eyes were full of yearning and yearning. She had a perfect figure under her lavender gauze skirt.
The slim figure, the ethereal temperament, and the faint Ningxiu temperament make this scene particularly beautiful.
This scene, like a freeze-frame, was firmly remembered in Jiang Chen's mind.
Jiang Chen did not break this beautiful scene, but Jiang Yun quickly came back to her senses and her eyes fell on Jiang Chen again.
"Okay, from now on, I will give you countless True Essence Pills and let you eat them until you vomit."
Jiang Chen said.
"Vulgar!"
"Hey Black."
"Jiang Chen, if you don't want to go to Tianjian Sect, what are you going to do in the future? Without the resources and competition of the sect, it would be difficult for us monks to achieve great development."
"Senior sister, I remember that your aunt is in Wanjian Sect, right?"
"Yes, it's just... Wanjian Sect and Wanxue Palace are next to each other. Do you... want to compete with Wanxue Palace at any time?"
"Yes, senior sister, Wanjian Sect is bigger than Tianjian Sect and is more suitable for growth. And the disciples of Wanjian Sect compete with Wanxue Palace every year. I want to go to Wanjian Sect and trample Gu Hao to death in the competition!"
After Jiang Chen pondered for a moment, he spoke his mind.
"You, Gu Hao, are now at the fifth level of the Tianyuan Realm. You... what are you comparing yourself to? Moreover, Wanjian Sect, even with my aunt's ability, may not be able to let you in. Your situation..."
"Senior sister, I just want a chance to take a test. Whether I succeed or not, all I have to do is try my best."
"The lowest entry threshold for Wanjian Sect is the True Yuan realm."
"I already have the strength of the ninth level of the Purple Qi Realm."
"What, you, you, you are actually at the 99th level of the Purple Qi realm!"
Hearing Jiang Chen's words, Jiang Yun was shocked, her beautiful eyes widened, and she stared at Jiang Chen with a look of disbelief in her eyes!
"Well, yes."
As Jiang Chen said, his strength at the ninth level of the Purple Qi Realm was directly displayed.
Sure enough, a mighty purple energy overflowed, and Jiang Yun's face showed a look of extreme shock.
Immediately, she rushed in front of Jiang Chen, then reached out and grabbed Jiang Chen's ears, twisting them hard.
"You heartless one! Sister, I have been worried about you for three years, but you pretend to be decadent, and instead secretly work hard to regain your strength! You are really heartless, heartless!"
Jiang Yun was very excited. When she pinched Jiang Chen's ears, she couldn't bear to use any force. Instead, she started to twist and burst into tears.
When Jiang Chen heard these words, his heart suddenly shook, and an inexplicable complex emotion shook his body and mind.
He couldn't control himself and subconsciously hugged Jiang Yun fiercely.
As soon as he hugged her, Jiang Chen immediately felt that Jiang Yun was trembling.
Jiang Chen knew that Jiang Yun was happy and excited.
However, after being moved, Jiang Chen's heart suddenly warmed up as he hugged this beautiful woman.
He comes from modern society, and his thoughts are not that of a gentleman.
Therefore, Jiang Chen felt angry and immediately hugged him tighter.
At the same time, Jiang Chen's hands were not honest at all.
At the beginning, Jiang Yun didn't feel anything. She just felt that three years of care and worry finally had a satisfactory answer. She felt a mixture of sadness and joy in her heart, so she didn't object to Jiang Chen's hug.
But then, she felt it.
"The hilt of your sword stabbed my leg."
Jiang Yun broke away from Jiang Chen's arms and said subconsciously.
But as soon as she finished speaking, she immediately realized something, and her pretty face suddenly turned red.
"You, you deceiver!"
Jiang Yun's pretty face turned even redder, and she suddenly spat lightly and said angrily.
"This, this is not intentional. After all, senior sister, you are so touching..."
Jiang Chen smiled coquettishly.
originallyThe other party hadn't noticed it before, but when this happened, the other party could know that his previous actions were definitely an opportunity to take advantage.
Jiang Yun glared at Jiang Chen fiercely, but she distanced herself from Jiang Chen obviously very defensively.
Thinking that she had held his hand and cared about him before, but then he stroked her hand instead, Jiang Yun also blushed - I'm afraid that at that time, this scoundrel was trying to take advantage of her!
Jiang Yunqiao blushed, and then she equated that innocent boy with an evil young man.
"Senior sister, this, haven't you always liked "Tianhe Sword Technique" before? Let me teach you "Tianhe Sword Technique"!"
As Jiang Chen said this, he glanced at his father Jiang Cangyun's tombstone again, and his originally good mood suddenly became much sadder.
He walked to the side of the tombstone, took out his sword, and used Tianhe Kendo to dig a one-meter-square pit.
Among them, Jiang Chen took out an iron box.
